ruleset: Historical vanilla 1.2.0 public Assembly Kit reference (190 CE)

interpretation.population: The snapshot uses integer thousands of people. A supplied person count is divided by 1000 with its fractional remainder discarded before band lookup. Population is the total in owned regions of the commandery, not only its capital. Population is fixed; growth, migration and replenishment are not optimized.
interpretation.population_scope: These are standard 190 CE population economy/public-order bands. Kong Rong/He Yi special trade or recruitment effects are separate rules.
interpretation.corruption: Raw difficulty/region-count reference points are retained for audit. Interpolation and in-engine rounding are not inferred; the current model takes base corruption as a supplied snapshot input.
interpretation.taxation: All tax levels and their scoped effects are retained. The initial optimizer uses the normal level; other taxation policies are not automatically chosen.
interpretation.fertility: Seasonal fertility bundles are retained without inventing per-commandery geographic assignments. The controlled baseline is normal fertility outside the harvest season unless explicit scenario inputs select another bundle.
interpretation.version: Historical 1.2.0 reference only. Later population and faction-rule changes are not mixed into these tables. This is not installed-build validation.
